The [White letters](https://neelsmith.quarto.pub/personal/familyhistory/whiteletters/) refer to three generations of family members. 

Add for Horatio and Syrena:

- Friend Adams White
- Frances E. White
- William E. White
- George A. White
- Candace White

Add for Artemas and Lydia

- Mary Ella White
- Candace M. White
- Frederick D. White
- Hiram White
